40006847.author: पदार्थः
40006847.content: राघवानुजः brother of Rama, सः लक्ष्मणः  Lakshmana, आश्रमपदम् at the hermitage, प्रविश्य  entered, अगस्त्यशिष्यम् disciple of Agastya, आसाद्य  met, एतत् all this, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह said.

40006847.author: Translation
40006847.content: Lakshmana, the younger brother of Rama,  entered the hermitage of Agastya and met one of his disciples and said to him these words :

40006848.author: पदार्थः
40006848.content: दशरथो नाम called Dasaratha, राजा king, तस्य his, ज्येष्ठः सुतः eldest son, बली strong, रामः Rama, भार्यया with wife, सीतया सह accompanied by Sita, मुनिम् to the sage, द्रष्टुम् to see, पाप्तः has come.

40006848.author: Translation
40006848.content: The valiant eldest son of  king Dasaratha has come along with his wife Sita to see the sage.

40006849.author: पदार्थः
40006849.content: अहं तु I am, तस्य his, अवरजः younger to him, लक्ष्मणो नाम Lakshmana by name, भ्राता brother, हितः wellwisher, अनुकूलश्च faithful, भक्तश्च devotee, ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः has been heard by you, यदि if at all.

40006849.author: Translation
40006849.content: I am his younger brother Lakshmana, his wellwisher and faithful devotee if you have at all heard about me.

40006850.author: पदार्थः
40006850.content: ते वयम् we, पितृशासनात् by the command of our father, अत्युग्रम् very dense, वनम् forest, प्रविष्टाः have entered, सर्वे all of us, भगवन्तम् divine sire, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामहे desire, निवेद्यताम् it may be reported to him.

40006850.author: Translation
40006850.content: By the command of our father, we have entered this dense forest and desire to see the   divine sire. Please report.

40006851.author: पदार्थः
40006851.content: तपोधनः the ascetic (endowed with wealth of penance), तस्य लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, तत् वचनम् his words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तथेति let it be so, उक्त्वा said, निवेदितुम् to report, अग्निशरणम् firesanctuary प्रविवेश entered.

40006851.author: Translation
40006851.content: The ascetic heard Lakshmana, and saying, 'let it be so', entered the firesanctuary to report.

40006852.author: पदार्थः
40006852.content: अगस्त्यस्य Agastya's, सम्मतः favourite, शिष्यः disciple, सः that, अञ्जसा promptly, प्रविश्य  entered, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, यथोक्तमेव as told by him, तपसा with penance, दुष्प्रधर्षणम्  who can not be violated , मुनिश्रेष्ठम् the best among the ascetics, रामागमनम् about Rama 's arrival, इदम् thus, उवाच said.

40006852.author: Translation
40006852.content: Having promptly entered, Agastya's favourite disciple with folded hands reported as he was told by Lakshmana about Rama's arrival to the great sage who was armed with the inviolable powers of penance :

40006853.author: पदार्थः
40006853.content: रामः Rama, लक्ष्मण एव च Lakshmana also, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, इमौ both, पुत्रौ sons, भार्यया with wife, सीतया सह accompanied by Sita, आश्रमपदम् to the hermitage, प्रविष्टौ entered.

40006853.author: Translation
40006853.content: Rama and Lakshmana, the two sons of Dasaratha along with Sita, wife of Rama, have arrived at the hermitage.

40006854.author: पदार्थः
40006854.content: अरिन्दमौ subduers of enemies (Rama and Lakshmana), भवन्तम् to your Holiness, द्रष्टुम् to see, शुश्रूषार्थम् to serve, अयातौ both have come, अत्र here, यत् whatever, अनन्तरम् nexl, तत् that, त्वम् you, आज्ञापयितुम् to order, अर्हसि you may be pleased to.

40006854.author: Translation
40006854.content: Both the subduers of enemies  have come here now to see and serve your Holiness. You may order what is to be done next.

40006855.author: पदार्थः
40006855.content: ततः then, शिष्यात् from the disciple, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, प्राप्तम् arrived, उपश्रुत्य having heard, महाभागाम् great, वैदेहीं Sita, daughter of the king of Videha, च and, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40006855.author: Translation
40006855.content: Having heard from the disciple about the arrival of Rama, Lakshmana and great daughter of the king of Videha the sage said :

40006856.author: पदार्थः
40006856.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, रामः Rama, चिरस्य after a long time, माम् me, द्रष्टुम् to see, अद्य today, समुपागतः arrived here luckily, अस्य his, आगमनं प्रति coming here, मया by me, मनसा at heart, काङ्क्षितं हि was desired indeed.

40006856.author: Translation
40006856.content: It is good fortune that Rama has come here after a long time to see me. I was longing for his arrival.

40006857.author: पदार्थः
40006857.content: गम्यताम् go (quickly), सभार्यः along with his wife, सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, सत्कृतः rendering due hospitality, मे my, समीपम् presence, प्रवेश्यताम् may be ushered in, असौ he, किम् why, न प्रवेशितः  not brought in so far ?

40006857.author: Translation
40006857.content: Go quickly and with due hospitality conduct Rama, his wife Sita and brother Lakshmana into my presence. Why was he not ushered in so long?

40006858.author: पदार्थः
40006858.content: धर्मज्ञेन by the knower of rightousness, महात्मना  by the great soul, मुनिना by the sage, एवम् thus, उक्तः  asked, शिष्यः disciple, नियताञ्जलिः with folded palms, अभिवाद्य  respectfully, तथेति ,so be it, अब्रवीत् said.

40006858.author: Translation
40006858.content: 'So be it ' said the disciple respectfully with folded palms in response to what the great sage, knower of dharma, commanded.

40006859.author: पदार्थः
40006859.content: ततः thereafter, शिष्यः the disciple, सम्भ्रान्तः exited, निष्क्रम्य after coming out, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, असौ he, रामः Rama, क्व where is he?, मुनिम् sage, द्रष्टुम् to see, एतु he may come, स्वयम् himself, प्रविशतु let him come in.

40006859.author: Translation
40006859.content: Then the disciple in a state of excitement came out of the hermitage and said to Lakshmana, 'Where is Rama? Let him come himself to see the sage'.

40006860.author: पदार्थः
40006860.content: ततः then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शिष्येण सह along with the disciple, आश्रमद्वारम् entrance of the hermitage, गत्वा after reaching, काकुत्स्थम् Rama of the Kakutstha family, जनकात्मजाम् daughter of Janaka, सीतां च Sita also, दर्शयामास showed.

40006860.author: Translation
40006860.content: Then Lakshmana reached the entrance of the hermitage with the disciple  and showed  Rama of the Kakutstha race and Sita, daughter of Janaka .

40006861.author: पदार्थः
40006861.content: शिष्यः disciple, प्रश्रितः most obediently, अगस्त्यवचनम् Agastya's words, वाक्यम् utterance, ब्रुवन् while informing, सत्कारार्हम् one who deserved hospitality, सुसत्कृम् treating with respect, तम् him, यथान्याम् in an appropriate way, प्रावेशयत् ushered in.

40006861.author: Translation
40006861.content: The disciple humbly reported Agastya's words and ushered him in with befitting hospitality.

40006862.author: पदार्थः
40006862.content: ततः then, रामः Rama, सीतया with Sita, सहलक्ष्मणः and with Lakshmana, प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णम् full of quietly moving deer, आश्रमम् hermitage, अवलोकयन् observing, प्रविवेश entered.

40006862.author: Translation
40006862.content: Then Rama, Sita and Lakshmana entered the hermitage, watching herds of quietly moving deer (undisturbed by their entry).

40006863.author: पदार्थः
40006863.content: सः he, तत्र there, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, स्थानम् place, तथैव च similarly, अग्नेः Fire's, स्थानम् place, विष्णोः Visnu's, स्थानम् place, तथा so also, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, विवस्वतः Sun's, स्थानं चैव place too, सोमस्थानम् Moon's place, भगस्थानम् place of Bhaga (one of the twelve forms of the Sun), कौबेरम् Kubera's, स्थानमेव च place too, धातुः Supreme Spirit, विधातुः the Creator's, स्थाने च place too, तथैव च ल like that, वायोः windgod's, स्थानम् place, नागराजस्य serpent king's, महात्मनः great soul's, अनन्तस्य Ananta's, स्थानम् place, तथैव like that, गायत्र्याः Gayatri's, स्थानम् place, वसूनाम् of Vasu's, स्थानमेव च place also, पाशहस्तस्य Pasahasta's(one who holds the noose in his hand to pull and punish the mortals), महात्मनः of the great soul, वरुणस्य water god Varuna's, स्थानं च place too, कार्तिकेयस्य Kartikeya's, स्थानं च place too, धर्मस्थानं च place of dharma, पश्यति he saw.

40006863.author: Translation
40006863.content: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking),  Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .

40006864.author: पदार्थः
40006864.content: सः he, तत्र there, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, स्थानम् place, तथैव च similarly, अग्नेः Fire's, स्थानम् place, विष्णोः Visnu's, स्थानम् place, तथा so also, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, विवस्वतः Sun's, स्थानं चैव place too, सोमस्थानम् Moon's place, भगस्थानम् place of Bhaga (one of the twelve forms of the Sun), कौबेरम् Kubera's, स्थानमेव च place too, धातुः Supreme Spirit, विधातुः the Creator's, स्थाने च place too, तथैव च ल like that, वायोः windgod's, स्थानम् place, नागराजस्य serpent king's, महात्मनः great soul's, अनन्तस्य Ananta's, स्थानम् place, तथैव like that, गायत्र्याः Gayatri's, स्थानम् place, वसूनाम् of Vasu's, स्थानमेव च place also, पाशहस्तस्य Pasahasta's(one who holds the noose in his hand to pull and punish the mortals), महात्मनः of the great soul, वरुणस्य water god Varuna's, स्थानं च place too, कार्तिकेयस्य Kartikeya's, स्थानं च place too, धर्मस्थानं च place of dharma, पश्यति he saw.

40006864.author: Translation
40006864.content: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking), Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .

40006865.author: पदार्थः
40006865.content: सः he, तत्र there, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, स्थानम् place, तथैव च similarly, अग्नेः Fire's, स्थानम् place, विष्णोः Visnu's, स्थानम् place, तथा so also, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, विवस्वतः Sun's, स्थानं चैव place too, सोमस्थानम् Moon's place, भगस्थानम् place of Bhaga (one of the twelve forms of the Sun), कौबेरम् Kubera's, स्थानमेव च place too, धातुः Supreme Spirit, विधातुः the Creator's, स्थाने च place too, तथैव च ल like that, वायोः windgod's, स्थानम् place, नागराजस्य serpent king's, महात्मनः great soul's, अनन्तस्य Ananta's, स्थानम् place, तथैव like that, गायत्र्याः Gayatri's, स्थानम् place, वसूनाम् of Vasu's, स्थानमेव च place also, पाशहस्तस्य Pasahasta's(one who holds the noose in his hand to pull and punish the mortals), महात्मनः of the great soul, वरुणस्य water god Varuna's, स्थानं च place too, कार्तिकेयस्य Kartikeya's, स्थानं च place too, धर्मस्थानं च place of dharma, पश्यति he saw.

40006865.author: Translation
40006865.content: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking),  Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .

40006866.author: पदार्थः
40006866.content: सः he, तत्र there, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, स्थानम् place, तथैव च similarly, अग्नेः Fire's, स्थानम् place, विष्णोः Visnu's, स्थानम् place, तथा so also, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, विवस्वतः Sun's, स्थानं चैव place too, सोमस्थानम् Moon's place, भगस्थानम् place of Bhaga (one of the twelve forms of the Sun), कौबेरम् Kubera's, स्थानमेव च place too, धातुः Supreme Spirit, विधातुः the Creator's, स्थाने च place too, तथैव च ल like that, वायोः windgod's, स्थानम् place, नागराजस्य serpent king's, महात्मनः great soul's, अनन्तस्य Ananta's, स्थानम् place, तथैव like that, गायत्र्याः Gayatri's, स्थानम् place, वसूनाम् of Vasu's, स्थानमेव च place also, पाशहस्तस्य Pasahasta's(one who holds the noose in his hand to pull and punish the mortals), महात्मनः of the great soul, वरुणस्य water god Varuna's, स्थानं च place too, कार्तिकेयस्य Kartikeya's, स्थानं च place too, धर्मस्थानं च place of dharma, पश्यति he saw.

40006866.author: Translation
40006866.content: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking),  Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .

40006867.author: पदार्थः
40006867.content: ततः thereafter, शिष्यैः by disciples, परिवृतः surrounded by, मुनिरपि sage also, अभिनिष्पतत् approaching, रामः Rama, दीप्ततेजसाम् shinnig brightly among them, मुनीनाम् of the sages, अग्रतः in the forefront, तम् him, ददर्श saw.

40006867.author: Translation
40006867.content: Thereafter surrounded by the disciples the sage came out. Rama saw him coming in front of the effulgent sages.

40006868.author: पदार्थः
40006868.content: वीरः  hero, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् augmenter of prosperity, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, भगवान् glorious, एषः this person, अगस्त्यः Agastya, ऋषिः sage, निष्क्रामति is coming here, औदार्येण by nobility, इमम् him, तपसाम् of penance, निधानम् a treasuretrove, अवगच्छामि I understand.

40006868.author: Translation
40006868.content: The valiant Rama said to Lakshmana, the enhancer of prosperity, O Lakshmana, sage Agastya is coming out. By virtue of his noble appearance, I know this sage to be a great treasuretrove of penances.

40006869.author: पदार्थः
40006869.content: वीरः  hero, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् augmenter of prosperity, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, भगवान् glorious, एषः this person, अगस्त्यः Agastya, ऋषिः sage, निष्क्रामति is coming here, औदार्येण by nobility, इमम् him, तपसाम् of penance, निधानम् a treasuretrove, अवगच्छामि I understand.

40006869.author: Translation
40006869.content: The valiant Rama said to Lakshmana, the enhancer of prosperity, O Lakshmana, sage Agastya is coming out. By virtue of his noble appearance, I know this sage to be a great treasuretrove of penances.

40006870.author: पदार्थः
40006870.content: महाबाहुः one with mighty arms, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, सूर्यवर्चसम् shining like the Sun, अगस्त्यस्य Agastya's, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, परमप्रीतः with great pleasure, तस्य his, पादौ feet, जग्राह grasped.

40006870.author: Translation
40006870.content: Having said so, the mightyarmed Rama, the scorcher of enemies, grasped the feet of Agastya who was shining like the Sun.

40006871.author: पदार्थः
40006871.content: तदा then, धर्मात्मा righteous self, रामः Rama, वैदेह्या with princess of Videha, सीतया with Sita, सलक्ष्मणः and with Lakshmana, अभिवाद्य having offered respects, कृताज्ञलिः with folded palms, तस्थौ stood.

40006871.author: Translation
40006871.content: Then righteous Rama with Sita, the princess of Videha, and Lakshmana offered respects with folded palmsstanding.

40006872.author: पदार्थः
40006872.content: आसनोदकैः seat and water, अर्चयित्वा honouring, काकुत्स्थम् to Rama (Kakutstha), प्रतिजग्राह received, कुशलप्रश्नम् made enquiries of his welfare, उक्त्वा said, आस्यताम् be seated, इति च these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40006872.author: Translation
40006872.content: Agastya received Rama by offering him seat and water, enquired about his wellbeing  and said: Please be seated,

40006873.author: पदार्थः
40006873.content: सः he, अग्निम् fire, हुत्वा after offering oblations, अर्घ्यम् water etc, प्रदाय after providing, अतिथीन् guests, प्रतिपूज्य च after worshipping, वानप्रस्थेन according to hermit's, धर्मेण tradition, तेषाम् to them, भोजनम् food, ददौ gave.

40006873.author: Translation
40006873.content: After giving oblations to the fire, and  providing respectful offerings, the sage worshipped the guests according to the tradition of hermits and served them food.

40006874.author: पदार्थः
40006874.content: अथ and then, धर्मज्ञः the knower of dharma, मुनिपुङ्गवः great among the sages, प्रथमम् first, उपविश्य after sitting, आसीनम् seated, प्राञ्जलिम् one with folded palms, धर्मकोविदम् knower of dharma, रामम् to Rama, उवाच said.

40006874.author: Translation
40006874.content: And then the great sage Agastya, knower of dharma  first took his seat and addressed Rama, an export in the knowledge of dharma, seated with folded palms.

40006875.author: पदार्थः
40006875.content: अग्निम् fire, हुत्वा after making an offering, अर्घ्यम् water, प्रदाय after providing, अतिथिम् guest, प्रतिपूजयेत् should worship, काकुत्स्थ O Rama, अन्यथा otherwise, समुदाचरन् by adopting, तपस्वी the sage, दुःसाक्षीव like a false witness, परे लोके in other world, स्वानि his own, मांसानि flesh, भक्षयेत् will have to eat.

40006875.author: Translation
40006875.content: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, only  after offering oblations to the Firegod, a guest should be worshipped with water etc. Otherwise the host will have to eat his own flesh in the other world like a false witness.

40006876.author: पदार्थः
40006876.content: सर्वस्य लोकस्य in all the worlds, राजा king, धर्मचारी follower of dharma, महारथः great warrior, पूजनीयश्च one worthy of worship, मान्यश्च esteemed self, भवान् you, प्रियातिथिः a dear guest, प्राप्तः have come to me.

40006876.author: Translation
40006876.content: You are king of all the worlds, a follower of dharma, a great warrior worthy of worship and an esteemed self. O Rama you are such a dear guest come to me.

40006877.author: पदार्थः
40006877.content: एवम् like this, उक्त्वा having said, राघवम् to Rama, फलैः with fruits, मूलैः with roots, पुष्पैः with flowers, अन्यैश्च with other things, यथाकामम् as he desired, पूजयित्वा after worshipping, ततः thereafter, पुनरेव again, अब्रवीत् said.

40006877.author: Translation
40006877.content: Having said this to Rama, (the sage) honoured him by offering fruits, roots, flowers and other things as desired. He then said to Rama once again:

40006878.author: पदार्थः
40006878.content: पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, हेमरत्नविभूषितम् adorned with gold and gems, दिव्यम् divine, महत् great, इदं चापम् this bow, वैष्णवम् belongs to Visnu, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, निर्मितम् designed, सूर्यसङ्काशः glittering like the Sun, अमोघः unfailing, शरोत्तमः best of arrows, ब्रह्मदत्तः given by Brahma.

40006878.author: Translation
40006878.content: O best among men  this divine bow studded with gold and gems  belongs to Visnu and designed by Visvakarma. This excellent, unfailing arrow, bright like the Sun, was given to me by Brahma.

40006879.author: पदार्थः
40006879.content: पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, हेमरत्नविभूषितम् adorned with gold and gems, दिव्यम् divine, महत् great, इदं चापम् this bow, वैष्णवम् belongs to Visnu, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, निर्मितम् designed, सूर्यसङ्काशः glittering like the Sun, अमोघः unfailing, शरोत्तमः best of arrows, ब्रह्मदत्तः given by Brahma.

40006879.author: Translation
40006879.content: O best among men  this divine bow studded with gold and gems  belongs to Visnu and designed by Visvakarma. This excellent, unfailing arrow, bright like the Sun, was given to me by Brahma.

40006880.author: पदार्थः
40006880.content: अक्षयसायकौ  with inexhaustible arrows, निशितैः  sharp ones, ज्वलद्भि: burning, पावकैरिव like fire, बाणैः with arrows, सम्पूर्णौ  filled, तूणी quiver, मम to me, महेन्द्रेण by Indra, दत्तौ were given, महारजतकोशः a big silver sheath, अयम् this, हेमविभूषितः adorned with gold.

40006880.author: Translation
40006880.content: These two quivers filled fully with sharp inexhaustible arrows, shining like flames of fire and this sword adorned with gold and this big silver sheath were given to me by Indra.

40006881.author: पदार्थः
40006881.content: राम O Rama, पुरा in the past, विष्णुः Visnu, सङ्ख्ये in the battle, अनेन धनुषा with this bow, महासुरान् great demons, हत्वा killing, दिवौकसाम् for the gods, दीप्ताम् shining, श्रियम् prosperity, आजहार earned.

40006881.author: Translation
40006881.content: In ancient times Visnu killed the demons in a battle with this bow and brought back the glittering prosperity for the gods.

40006882.author: पदार्थः
40006882.content: मानद O Rama, bestower of honour, तत् that, धनुः bow, तौ both, तूणीरौ quivers, शरम् arrow, खङ्गं च sword, वज्रधरः Indra the wielder of the thunderbolt, वज्रं यथा as his thunderbolt, जयाय to win, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व you may please accept.

40006882.author: Translation
40006882.content: O bestower of honour, receive this bow, the two quivers, the sword and the arrow for your victory just like Indra accepts the thunderbolt.

40006883.author: पदार्थः
40006883.content: महातेजा: luminous , भगवान् lord, अगस्त्यः Agastya, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, समस्तम् everything, तत् that, वरायुधम् excellent weapons, रामाय to Rama, दत्वा having given, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said.

40006883.author: Translation
40006883.content: The luminous lord Agastya, having said this, gave all the excellent weapons to Rama. And continued : इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
